mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,purpose,token_digest,status,active_marker,expires_at,consumed_at,revoked_at, issued_by,reason,target_value_digest,target_profile_version,version,create_time FROM t_account_credential WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND purpose=#{purpose} AND active_marker=1 AND status='ISSUED'

SELECT id,user_id,purpose,token_digest,status,active_marker,expires_at,consumed_at,revoked_at, issued_by,reason,target_value_digest,target_profile_version,version,create_time FROM t_account_credential WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND purpose IN #{purpose} ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_account_credential SET status='REVOKED',active_marker=NULL,revoked_at=#{revokedAt},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND purpose=#{purpose} AND active_marker=1 AND status='ISSUED'
UPDATE t_account_credential SET status='REVOKED',active_marker=NULL,revoked_at=#{revokedAt},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND status='ISSUED'

UPDATE t_account_credential SET status='CONSUMED',active_marker=NULL,consumed_at=#{consumedAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND active_marker=1 AND status='ISSUED' AND expires_at > #{consumedAt}
UPDATE t_account_credential SET status='REVOKED',active_marker=NULL,revoked_at=#{revokedAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND active_marker=1 AND status='ISSUED'
